name: The dungeon's trapped rooms
note: Design map (M13.0). The new part of Liscor's dungeon under the rift, reached by ropes hanging from a hole in the ceiling (4.08 T, 4.19). The rooms come from the text: the rope landing, a corridor of glowing runes and a pit with stone spikes (4.08 T), a room whose ceiling spikes drop, a library of books that explode when read and a grate that sprays acid (4.19), and a shaft full of Shield Spider webs (4.08 T). In the Book the rooms change on each visit; here they stay put. The order, sizes and the stairs down to the crypt level are guesses. The ropes open with liscor_dungeon.new_section_found. M13.T traps: the runes recharge and the ceiling spikes reset after about an hour (4.19); the acid eats magic protection (4.19; there is no magic protection here). Only one tile of each two-wide passage is trapped. The fire room of 4.19 is not placed. The spots are guesses.
